chunks: He made those of the People of the Book who had helped them descend from their forts, and cast dread into their hearts, so you killed some and took captive others.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the Banu Qurayzah during the Battle of the Confederacy?
ai.summary: In the context of the Battle of Banu Qurayzah, this verse highlights Allah's divine intervention in causing the Jewish tribe to descend from their fortified castles (Sawasih) and instilling terror (Ru'b) in their hearts. This psychological and physical disarray led to the Muslims executing some and taking others as captives, a key event in establishing Islamic authority in Medina. The term 'Sawasih' refers specifically to their strongholds, emphasizing the completeness of their defeat.
